raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-NGA-AgroProcessingLivelihood",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "A drop in agricultural output market prices exceeding 10 percent would cause net present values to turn negative and internal rates of return to fall below the cost of capital, undermining financial viability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish aggregation centers, grain exchange platforms, and structured out-grower business alliances with off-takers to secure market prices and smooth seasonal volatility.",
      "evidence": "if benefits were reduced by 20 percent... the net present values will turn negative while the IRR were also below the cost of capital."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Low procurement capacity and lack of standardized procurement tools in participating states could cause procurement delays, inappropriate contract awards, and slow project execution.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Competitive recruitment of experienced state procurement officers backed by an expert procurement consultant hired by the NCO to train and support state staff.",
      "evidence": "The procurement capacity is still considered low and most of the states do not have procurement tools in place."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Unretired travel advances and inadequate supporting documentation for expenditures in PFMUs and FPFMD could lead to ineligible expenses, financial mismanagement, and delayed disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce an enhanced accountability framework in the Financial Procedures Manual, including strict advance acquittal rules and risk-based internal auditing.",
      "evidence": "The key issues noted within the PFMUs and FPFMD are unretired advances and inadequate documentation of the eligible expenditures incurred."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Civil insecurity, regional unrest, or militant activities in project regions could threaten project personnel, disrupt supply chains, and delay physical infrastructure works.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Concentrate interventions in secure agricultural clusters, maintain close security monitoring, and actively engage local community leadership and stakeholders.",
      "evidence": "compound by additional factors including a sharp drop in oil production levels due to militant activities in the Niger Delta region"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Land acquisition for processing clusters and infrastructure could cause involuntary resettlement, loss of access to common resources like grazing lands, and community disputes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply the Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF) to screen all civil works, minimize land acquisition, and implement site-specific Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs) where required.",
      "evidence": "infrastructure investments could result in involuntary re-settlement and land requisition"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Intensified use of agricultural chemicals (fertilizers, pesticides) and small civil works could pollute soil and surface water, generate runoffs, and damage local ecosystems.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Execute environmental screening under the Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF) and implement the Integrated Pest Management Plan (IPMP).",
      "evidence": "agricultural intensification involving the use of inputs, could potentially have adverse impact on soil, water and vegetation covers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Extending power lines, gas pipelines, and utilities to processing clusters could encroach upon or degrade sensitive natural habitats such as swamps and marshes.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce strict site screening under Operational Policy 4.04 (Natural Habitats) to route infrastructure lines away from ecologically sensitive wetlands.",
      "evidence": "extension of electricity transmission lines and installation of gas pipelines might pass through important natural habitats such as swamps and marshes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Prevalence of fake or adulterated agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizer, agro-chemicals) on the market could depress crop productivity and cause financial loss to farmers.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance to FMARD and regulatory bodies (e.g., NASC, NAFDAC) to strengthen input quality control and accredit reliable agro-dealers.",
      "evidence": "support to FMARD... on quality control of agro-inputs such as seeds, fertilizer and agro-chemicals to address issues of adulteration"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Delays by participating states in ratifying subsidiary agreements or issuing legal opinions could block disbursements under Categories 1, 2, and 3 and freeze state operations.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide early technical and legal support to state governments during project preparation to ensure rapid execution and legal ratification of subsidiary agreements.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawal shall be made... with respect to any Participating State unless the Association has received an opinion... that the Subsidiary Agreement has been duly authorized"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Weak producer negotiation capacity, mistrust, or side-selling by farmers could lead to contract default in out-grower schemes and business alliances with commercial buyers.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Structure formal business alliance contracts, build governance and managerial capacity in producer cooperatives, and engage dedicated business development service providers.",
      "evidence": "weak market negotiation ability of small producers vis-à-vis buyers and input providers to obtain better prices and more stable market relationships"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Gender disparities in access to productive land, credit, and technology could exclude women farmers from full participation in value chain opportunities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy Sub-component 2.1 startup grants dedicated to women and youth, setting a target of at least 50% female participation monitored via a gender tracker.",
      "evidence": "women in Nigeria, compared with men, have relatively limited access to productive agricultural land, inputs and services."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "High commercial interest rates (up to 29 percent) and restricted credit availability could prevent farmers and agribusiness SMEs from securing complementary working capital.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide direct catalytic grant funding (matching and startup grants) and build commercial linkages between farmer cooperatives, off-takers, and financial institutions.",
      "evidence": "Limited access to financial services and high cost of capital is a serious constraint to modernization of the agriculture sector in Nigeria."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Inadequate management structures or lack of clear operation and maintenance (O&M) funding arrangements could lead to rapid deterioration of common processing facilities and link roads.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Require established management structures and 100 percent beneficiary commitment to coverage of O&M costs prior to financing common infrastructure assets.",
      "evidence": "establish a management structure and O&M arrangement for each infrastructure before investing in such undertakings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Disruptions or delays during the 18-month transition and competitive recruitment of permanent APPEALS project staff from the existing CADP structure could slow initial implementation.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Retain experienced CADP core staff during the initial 18-month period while conducting competitive recruitment under World Bank oversight.",
      "evidence": "During the first 18-month period of project implementation, it is expected that selection and replacement of CADP staff will be completed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "High post-harvest losses due to poor handling and lack of primary aggregation and cleaning facilities could reduce marketable volumes and lower income for producers.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Construct and equip 90 commodity aggregation centers with post-harvest handling, sorting, cleaning, and cottage processing equipment.",
      "evidence": "support the reduction of post-harvest losses, facilitate the consolidation of produce and primary processing by farmers' cooperative societies"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Erratic protectionist trade tariffs and border smuggling could destabilize domestic prices for key staples like rice and undercut domestic producer competitiveness.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Improve domestic value chain efficiency and processing quality to build competitive advantages against smuggled goods, supported by policy dialogue with FMARD.",
      "evidence": "Erratic protectionist tariffs, which encourage smuggling of rice across borders"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Macroeconomic recession and oil revenue collapse could impair state government budgets, leading to liquidity shortages and fiscal stress across participating states.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide 100 percent IDA financing for project costs requiring no state counterpart funding, supported by performance-based resource allocations.",
      "evidence": "The collapse of oil prices and the liquidity crunch revived tensions between federal government and subnational governments regarding burden of the adjustment"
    }
  ]
}
